يلتحقا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِقَا (yaltaḥiqā) /jal.ta.ħi.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# يُلْتَحَقَا (yultaḥaqā) /jul.ta.ħa.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
